summary.text: Cecelie Williams is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House of Representatives District 111 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A small business owner, she was born in Hermann, Missouri.

paragraphs.text: Williams was born in Hermann, Missouri, and attended Grandview High School; her career experience includes working as a small business owner.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she said she lives in Dittmer, Missouri, owns two small businesses in Cedar Hill with her husband, and is a board member of the Big River Ambulance District.
For the 2025-2026 session, she was assigned to the Elementary and Secondary Education Committee, the House General Laws Committee and the Professional Registration and Licensing Committee.
